name: Alicia Florence
original_name: アリシア·フローレンス
source:
The only other undine in Aria Company, Alicia is one of the Three Water Fairies of Neo-Venezia, known by the title "Snow White." 

At the start of the series, she is the most popular undine in the city, noted especially for her graceful rowing style. She was promoted to Prima at 15, the youngest ever to do so. Like Akari, she is relaxed and easy-going, but she also likes to tease others, especially her childhood friend Akira. 

Her favorite phrase is ara ara ("Well Well") and she frequently giggles, to Akira's annoyance. According to Grandma Akino, she is an excellent undine because of her ability to enjoy everything
